question: The Hindu College was established in Benaras in _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**1791.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Hindu College was established in** Benaras in 1791.**
 
• The Hindu College was established by the efforts of **Raja Balwant Singh,** a local landlord and philanthropist. 
 
• The college was initially named as the **Sanskrit College** and later renamed as **The Hindu College in 1812.**
 
• The college was affiliated to the **University of Calcutta in 1857**.
 
• The college played a significant role in the **Indian independence movement, **with notable alumni such as** Madan Mohan Malaviya and Motilal Nehru.**
